changes.notes: Expanded the two oils and three abbreviated culture collection spans to their complete textual mentions.
Removed disease effects attributed to TMA lyase inhibitors rather than the engineered strain; retained the strain's stated metabolic action and added its indole-acetate production.
Removed mango as an isolation source and its false INHABITS relation; the strain acted through fermented mango extract but was not stated to inhabit mango.
Removed a self-category symbiosis error and added the three explicit strain-host symbioses while retaining their broader INHABITS links.
Removed reversed causal relations: LI0758 inhibited yeast growth; W303-1A and BY4741 were affected strains, not inhibitory agents. Also trimmed punctuation.
Trimmed sentence punctuation from the disease span.
Removed the organism-level inhibition inferred from disruption of an infection effect; the explicit inhibition of stomatal reopening remains.
Trimmed punctuation from manually added compounds and expanded the cardiovascular disease span to include symptoms.
Expanded bare ATCC identifiers to complete strain mentions.
Removed all four symbiosis positives because the sentence explicitly describes these strain-cultivar combinations as incompatible.
Corrected NEC from a phenotype phrase to the disease mention used by the explicit protective relation.
Moved the symbiosis relation from the unrelated Azolla host to the cycad from which this Nostoc strain was isolated.
Trimmed Tucson, added the separately listed IS strain, and retained only sentence-local strain-host symbiosis links.
Converted verb-containing phenotype spans and PRESENTS links into the explicit inhibition of biofilm formation and virulence.
Removed a word-fragment phenotype and two relations contradicted by sentence scope: NGR234 is contrasted with nitrogen fixation, and V. unguiculata belongs to the G49 host list.
Reassigned relations to the entities actually described: AC1100 degrades the xenobiotic, BR3459a is the Mimosa symbiont, and the Piptadenia statement applies to the species rather than either strain.
Split the malformed combined OR191/LPU83 strain span and retained a conservative Medicago symbiosis link for the added OR191 mention.
Replaced indirect strain-DIO effects with the explicitly stated production of the protective fatty-acid metabolite by each listed strain.
Trimmed two strain boundaries and retyped Candidatus Evansia muelleri as a species; the resulting species-host relation is outside the configured strain relation taxonomy and was removed.
Removed the out-of-taxonomy strain-species PROMOTES edge and a contextual biofilm PRESENTS edge; the configured strain-phenotype growth promotion relation captures the stated effect.
Removed the nested marmoset ISOLATE span; marmoset is the host organism, not a stated isolation material in this sentence.
Expanded both observed phenotypes to include their direction and linked the strain to the enhanced biomass phenotype as well as impaired biofilm formation.
Trimmed commas from two strain spans.
Removed an adjective and an exact cross-type duplicate, and represented A. flavus as a microbial species.
Removed food security as a phenotype; it is a metaphorical description, not an organism phenotype.
